1rz3o29: Algo and nada refer to things; alguien and nadie, to people. With the indefinite after the verb, no is needed: no veo nada, no viene nadie. Before the verb, the negative indefinite is enough: nadie viene. Algún and ningún go before a masculine singular noun; alguna and ninguna before a feminine one.

t4x0y4: Que adds information about a person or thing: una bolsa que tiene dos bolsillos. Donde locates a place: la sala donde esperamos. If you don't know a word, explain shape, material, and use: es una cosa de metal que sirve para abrir botellas. In lost property, don't post unnecessary private information; give a detail that lets the object be recognized.
